stories.text: Russia legalizes crypto with new investor rules
stories.summary: Russia passed a new law legalizing cryptocurrency, establishing rules for investors, licensed exchanges, and payment restrictions, impacting the global market.

stories.text: Galaxy Digital pledges $5M for quantum-resistant Bitcoin
stories.summary: Galaxy Digital committed $5 million to develop quantum-resistant protections for Bitcoin, addressing the growing quantum threat.

stories.text: White House backs ethics provision in crypto bill
stories.summary: The White House agreed to an ethics provision in a cryptocurrency regulation bill, pushing for Senate passage.

stories.text: Charles Schwab launches Bitcoin and Ethereum trading
stories.summary: Charles Schwab introduced direct Bitcoin and Ethereum trading for retail clients after reporting record quarterly revenue.
An exploit of the Balance Coin stablecoin caused a 99% price crash and $912K loss, highlighting critical oracle flaws in DeFi.
